'''Gans Dent''' was the associate director of [[Galladinium Galactic Exports]]. After [[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology]] was banned in the [[Spirva sector/Legends|Spirva sector]], Dent confirmed that the company would comply with the edict and cancel all orders originating in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]].
